title: Savings Finder – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects, uses, and discloses your personal information when you use the Savings Finder service.

faqs.q: What information is collected when I use Savings Finder?
faqs.a: Service NSW collects your full name, phone number, post code, and email address.

faqs.q: Why do you need my personal information?
faqs.a: The information is used to personalize recommendations for savings and rebates you may be eligible for, and to provide you with your results and appointment summary.

faqs.q: Do I have to provide this information?
faqs.a: You are required to provide this information to receive personalized recommendations for savings or to receive your Savings Finder results and appointment summary.
